action: Compose and publish one customer-private OMA application OCI
scope: Customer application-material OCI publication only. No Instance deployment, Workspace availability, formal Cloud Product Release, production promotion, provider mutation or real-money mutation.

ssotClassification.buildOwner: Build owns immutable OCI construction and digest readback.
ssotClassification.registryRole: TCR stores the versioned application material for the customer.
ssotClassification.issue356: Related Cloud account-admission context only; it does not add an Instance deployment prerequisite to this application-material publication.

buildChain: Capability package input is the exact OMA archive identified by archive, candidate and content digests.
Build binds the package, the selected Runtime digest and the selected WebUI digest as one immutable input snapshot.
BuildKit composes the package at /agent and WebUI files from /app/dist/webui into /app/aionui-web/static while retaining the Runtime entrypoint and command.
The composed linux/amd64 OCI is exported to the customer-private TCR repository.
The remote TCR manifest is read back by the final digest; the published image contains /agent/agent/agent-pack.json and /app/aionui-web/static/index.html.

verification.runtimeHealthz: observed 200/ok during the first container startup probe
verification.localOwnerChain: Capability upload, Runtime/WebUI registration and selection, BuildKit composition, Ledger event persistence, lost-ack replay and post-registry worker recovery passed

boundaries: The earlier pending publication receipt remains historical evidence for the pre-closeout attempt; this append-only receipt records the completed publication.
No claim is made that Instance formally received, deployed or accepted this artifact.
No claim is made that the artifact is available in a Workspace or that a formal Cloud Product Release was published.
The stable browser-page probe was not used as a publication prerequisite; its bounded startup limitation remains recorded in the historical publication receipt.
